第一卷 第17章 碾压四人秘境立威（第1页）
那黑衣弟子整个人砸落在草丛之中，手臂扭曲浮肿，痛得浑身抽搐，根本爬不起来。
三名外门弟子瞳孔骤缩，背脊瞬间发凉。
区区炼气二层，还是个肉身腐朽的百岁老者！
怎么可能一掌击溃炼气五层的同门？
而且赢得如此干净利落，完全是碾压！
短暂惊骇过后，一名高个弟子咬牙嘶吼。
三道灵力光束齐齐迸发，封锁苏玄尘所有闪避方位。
在他们看来，刚才只是师兄大意失手。
苏玄尘面色依旧淡然，不见半分慌乱。
他的灵力，是极品天灵根凝练而出。
再加上《青元养身诀》洗脉固本，他的肉身强度，早已远超表面的老朽模样。
看似缓慢，却精准避开所有灵力轰击。
三道术法尽数落空，炸碎身后林木，尘土飞扬。
双掌轻拂，两缕精纯灵力瞬间迸发。
两名炼气四层弟子根本来不及防御，胸口瞬间被灵力击中。
两人脸色一白，身躯倒飞数米，重重落地，浑身酸软无力，灵力彻底溃散。
最后剩下那名炼气三层的弟子，吓得浑身僵硬，双腿发抖。
一眨眼功夫，四名围堵强者，倒了三个！
眼前这白发老者，哪里是什么软柿子？
他再也不敢停留，转身就要狂奔逃命。
抬手一指，一缕纤细如针的灵力破空而出。
那弟子惨叫一声，踉跄摔倒在地，再也无法移动半步。
四名气势汹汹、意图劫掠欺人的外门弟子。
四名弟子躺在地上，满脸惊恐、悔恨、难以置信。
自己仗着修为强横，想欺负百岁老朽、掠夺资源。
“恃强凌弱，寻衅夺宝，便是咎由自取。”
他语气平淡，却字字落在四人心里。
苏玄尘目光扫过地上几人，没有伤人性命。
他弯腰，将四人身上的储物布袋一一取下。
修仙界，败者资源归胜者，天经地义。
打开布袋，灵石、低阶丹药、数株普通灵药，尽数入目。
最后，他看向整片长势完好的月华草药田。
整片数十株月华草，青翠欲滴，灵气充沛。
这四人拼死争夺的机缘，此刻尽数归他所有。

Volume 1, Chapter 17: Crush Four People in the Secret Realm to Establish Power (Page 1)
The black-clothed disciple fell completely into the grass, his arms were twisted and swollen, his whole body was twitching in pain, and he couldn't get up at all.
The pupils of the three outer disciples shrank suddenly, and their spines instantly felt cold.
He's only on the second level of Qi Refining, but he's still a hundred-year-old man with a decaying body!
How could it be possible to defeat a fellow disciple at the fifth level of Qi Refining with one palm?
And winning so cleanly, it was a complete crush!
After a brief moment of shock, a tall disciple gritted his teeth and roared.
Three spiritual beams burst out together, blocking all Su Xuanchen's dodge directions.
In their opinion, it was just a careless mistake by the senior brother.
Su Xuanchen's expression remained calm, without any hint of panic.
His spiritual power is condensed from the highest quality heavenly spiritual roots.
Coupled with the "Qingyuan Body Nurturing Technique" to cleanse and strengthen the veins, his physical strength has already far exceeded his superficial appearance.
It seems slow, but it accurately avoids all spiritual bombardments.
All three spells failed, shattering the trees behind him and sending dust flying into the air.
With a flick of his palms, two strands of pure spiritual power burst out instantly.
The two fourth-level Qi Refining disciples had no time to defend themselves, and their chests were instantly hit by spiritual power.
Their faces turned pale, their bodies flew several meters upside down, and landed heavily on the ground. Their bodies were sore and weak, and their spiritual power was completely dissipated.
The last remaining disciple at the third level of Qi Refining was so frightened that his whole body was stiff and his legs were trembling.
In the blink of an eye, three of the four surrounding strong men fell!
How could the white-haired old man in front of me be such a soft persimmon?
He didn't dare to stay any longer, turned around and ran for his life.
He raised his hand and pointed, and a wisp of spiritual power as thin as a needle shot out of the air.
The disciple screamed, staggered and fell to the ground, unable to move another step.
Four aggressive outer disciples intent on robbing and bullying others.
The four disciples were lying on the ground, their faces full of horror, regret, and disbelief.
He relied on his cultivation to be tyrannical and wanted to bully the centenarian and plunder resources.
"Bullying the weak by relying on the strong, picking fights and seizing treasures is your own fault."
His tone was calm, but every word fell into the hearts of the four of them.
Su Xuanchen glanced at the people on the ground, but no one was hurt.
He bent down and took off the storage bags from the four people one by one.
In the world of immortality, the resources of the loser go to the winner, which is natural and right.
Opening the bag, spiritual stones, low-level elixirs, and several common elixirs all came into view.
Finally, he looked at the entire field of Yuehua Herbs, which was growing intact.
There are dozens of moonflower grasses in the whole area, which are green and full of spiritual energy.
The opportunities that these four people fought desperately for now belong to him.
